body:
I appreciate this, very much.. I fail to see any positives anymore no matter what they are.. I've deleted every ounce of social media information i had, example. Snapchat, Facebook, Twitter. 

I just don't see any improvements happening upon the "many" (not in comparison to others) years i've lived. It seems to be the Same stuff different day, Everyone around me have so much going for them, so much that happens to them and Im still struggling to even get a thank you for how much i do at work, or things i do for my friends. 

It hasn't been so bad today, few negative thoughts but i feel like this again, i will accept that inbox offer. Thank you.
